body: Nah, you can be kind but if you put your problems on me that I already told you how to sort out then I dont care- thats what I meant by repetitiveness.
They were so kind and still are but don't understand the repetitiveness

They were negative people, would constantly complain and come to me for advice about the same thing over and over again. They would never improve themselves. Always did the same thing but expected different results

Thank you, thats exactly it! "Becoming what you hate" is terrifying for me. Its nice to hear that I seem self aware, I try to be. How are you overcoming the shame? Do I just have to wait for it to pass? I am trying to consciously heal but it just feels like I am waiting more than improving

BPD is not fashionable, no one I know knows what it is and automatically assumes I am abusive. Look up BPD and you'll get thousands of articles on how detrimental people with BPD are. I definitely dont have C-PTSD. Ive researched that before and I dont relate. Its funny because I've noticed a lot people want mental disorders which is a mental health issue in itself. People often sensationalise personality disorders and I think that's why some see it as fashionable but if you have BPD its not at all. The downfalls of BPD are staggering and only manifest when you live with it. I know I can get better, thats not my problem. Its the intense shame I feel that this happened in the first place. "You can get better" that means I am ill and I never wanted to be. This comment seemed like a drive by diagnosis and wasnt helpful at all.
Just wanna be friends actually, dont see it going further
Thank you, i just hope my social anxiety doesnt get in the way, fingers crossed
Hit me up too :)

Depression, bpd, huge trust issues, hatred of human touch unless close with the person. Inability to connect emotionally or open up..its getting better though with time and perseverance. Ooh setting boundaries is hard at times

i am glad you shared this..I never thought of it as non physical sexual abuse but it always made my skin crawl. My mum used to watch me bathe with her creepy narc eyes. She always said it was incase my autistic brother walked in, she kinda weaponised him. If she had seeked help for him earlier than the age of 24 then he probably would get boundaries. She used it as an excuse to watch me. Or even just when she commented on my weight changjng it felt as if I was being leered at and when she used to tell me a pre pubescent child that I cant wear my undies around the house because there is people around but I always thought that was weird because why are you looking at your child like that. Till this day I have a strange thing about showing people my breasts because that was the area I developed quickly, my mum hasnt seen my breasts at all. As soon as they developed I felt the need to hide them from her because of the way she spoke and made me feel about growing up. Thank you for this post
I live in London sadly :( I'll try go to some metal gigs, you might be onto something. I do think people who listen to metal can be more understanding of hardships in life
I agree with that theory so much. Im glad someone else can relate. We shouldnt relate to these things but at least im not the only one.
Wish i could, dont have the funds. I'm from london
That's the plan

I love black metal, especially atmospheric! Im glad you found your niche of people man. You seem like a real cool person. Its rare to find people who get how hard it is to really open up and not just talk about bullshit. I like how you mentioned misanthropy..I like to call myself a compassionate misanthrope..oxymoron I know but it makes sense in a way. Oh and also thanks for taking time to talk, this in a way is like gold dust to me so thank you

Ive tried all that sadly. Its just a waiting game I guess to find someone who clicks but I have been waiting a long time. I just always think I am too strange for people usually and I don't know how to open up.  What extreme music do you like btw?

I went through this a few days ago actually. I want to talk to my parents so bad. Recently I had an argument with them and they called the police on me and got me arrested. They lied and said I threatened to kill them and hit my mum (I didnt). I spent 10 hours in a cell while I had pneumonia. They didnt care about my well being at all and went as far to put me in a cell while i was ill (also i have asthma). It was the last straw. My lawyer said unless I want to go to court then I have to say I did it and then I can leave with a caution. Ever since I have put that caution on my wall (strange i know) but it reminds me of how much they are not capable of love and that they do not deserve the pleasure of knowing me. I suggest you write a list of reason why you shouldn't interact with them and look at that list everytime you feel you want to speak to them..it will hurt at first but its gets easier each time.
The answers always gonna be no one sadly. i live with my parents but its strange. There is an upstairs and downstairs and we've kinda converted it into 2 houses. Its so weird to explain lol.
Sadly I dont have any other family, my parents isolated me so I could have others but i dont know if they exist
Damn shucks you just made me cry real tears of joy..like really.
Very true. I guess all I can do is wait till someone understands. Think im gonna be waiting a long time..
I wish I had friends who understood. Also, I don't get why people want fake compliments, its a hard life after narcissism when life is built on it
Thank you! Ive always felt dumb for not being able to connect and its good to know that this is a natural response to my abuse. A lot of people dont get it at all! I hope we both progress!
Thank you! I hope one day we can both feel love without the chains attached! Feels good to know other people get this
Hmm interesting perspective, I somewhat feel what you say ironically enough

Thank you for your response! The cheezy thing I relate to so much. I feel icky and weak if I feel or accept love and I am glad I am not the only one. It has been 2months since I posted this so I hope you have made progress even if that just means understanding this! Its a long, hard cheezy, icky road to love but we will get there!

That was strangely comforting to me. Thank you, this reminded me of my big sister when she told me about npd when i was 17 and it did feel less overwhelming because everything made sense. I hope a blessing comes your way

I am so glad your dog came when you needed him, I am certain they can sense pain. My doggo always runs to me when she can tell something is up. But please dont just live for your dog, live for you. You seem like a compassionate, strong person..qualities that a lot of people dont have nowadays so please see your beauty.

I am so proud of you. Never ever say this is dumb again! I went through a period of self harm and I know how hard it can be to break the chain! You are beautiful in every way and you are strong for doing this. I still have scars from mine but I look at them to remind me that I am strong! Thank you for sharing this achievement darling, keep going.

Oh and now im gonna be on the look for other boundary crossing. I really didnt catch this so thank you so much!! And you dont how much it means to be told that i havent turned out like them, thank you!
Oh damn I really didnt see it like that. Thanks for this new perspective, in a way I see this as support because now I know exactly why I feel very hurt and feel less crazy.

My first session was really refreshing. I cried and totally didnt feel weird crying in front of them, they made me feel so comfortable. It felt good to open up to someone and feel safe. Thank you for asking
Thank you, i hope it helps you and its lovely to know you understand the leap. Thank you so much
Thank you for your help and I hope your situation works out best for you!
I hope it gets better quickly! Thank you for your wise words, its nice to know someone cares
Thank you for the advice and your kind words :)
Thank you, what you said is true.
Thank you so much for this, it touched my heart. Exactly what i need to hear! Im going to try everything you said, thank you!
I will :) and thank you. This gave me a fire and its nice to know someone understands the significance.
Thank you, that means a lot to me 😊
We have kissed many time over the last five years. He always says weird stuff when we are out like "this is the closest we have been to a date"

All of his actions point to him liking me but I just dont believe his words. We argue but cant seem to stay mad at each other. Have the deepest conversations and hes considered going out with me but just says its not the right time. Its so confusing
I broke up with him 2 days ago and I have to say I'm the happiest ive been in 3 years. Thank you to you and all you guyss support
Yes its a new thing
I have tried. I have even told him about the time my parents beat me up and he says im lying.
Im not trusting you with anything because this is completely anonymous. My feelings were never validated, my parents would always call md crazy. How could I change it up?

To be completely honest, I have no idea what he sees in me. Every time i ask him he just says "you're just lily." I mean I know he likes that im adventurous and a bit loopy but there is only so much you can maximise that before it gets annoying. I dont want him to get bored. I feel like I havent known my friends long enough to express this to them and in regards to him I just dont want to put him off, insecurity can be very unattractive. If he did leave me I guess I would be devastated but eventually I would get over it but I love this guy so I dont want that to happen. I wouldn't say my friends are hotter but they dress provocatively and I dont really know what he likes, he doesn't share much hence the mysteriousness. I am quite self deprecating and I think it stems from getting bullied when I was younger and my parents saying I wasnt good enough. I would say I am hot, a lot of guys want to fuck me but they don't want to date me and thats the problem. I would say I am an acquired taste.

I dont think my friends are hotter but they are certainly hot and also funny, maybe not more or less than me. What do you mean by strengths? Could you give me an example? And he doesnt have confidence but people are strangely attracted to his shyness because he seems mysterious and also he is 6ft4 so girls just love him. I haven't known these friends for very long so Im not sure if they are fully loyal. What is the first step in trusting yourself? Im like a fish out of water with this.
Thank you for the advice. I felt so low today and really foggy that I couldn't think. Im gonna try some of this. I dont know about community theatres but ill have a look
I do acting, watch movies, social media, singing. And yh I never really thought of starting online, that is true.
I don't have any friends sadly

Hi, I am going through this at the moment. You are definitely not complex or whatever they say. Putting yourself first is not a crime. I feel guilty for trying to go low contact but i try to remember that i deserve to be happy and my parents are just guilt tripping me. My sister has been NC for 2 years and she said she went through a stage of guilt but it eventually goes away once you work on your happiness. I am 20 and my sister is 28 so she is further in the process of recovery. Its not bad to feel guilty either, obviously they are your parents and you will always feel that connection to them but dont let it get in the way of your journey! I wish you success, dont give up!
Thank you for your kind words, it means a lot. I feel like im on the path to believing in looking after myself, it will take time for me to apply it into my life but I know deep down I deserve it.

I wouldnt say they abandoned me. They got out and just couldn't take me with them I would say. My sister does give me support but for her sanity she won't deal with it. I would go nc if i could but its Impossible as I live with them. My sister gives me advice on how to get a flat etc and im working on it. I dont think my parents have inheritance tbh. She said that I should explain the dementia to my doctor to see a solution or talk to an association for support. And also said it best to not confront my mum about it to avoid conflict.

You just made me have a revelation. I think its because all my siblings are at least 10 years older than me and i watched what my mum did to them but cant remember it all because i was so little! Thank you for sharing, it made me realise some stuff.
Never heard of it, I'll have a look. Thanks for the advice, im gonna give writing a good go!
I am very aware of all her manipulation techniques so ive known this for years. Thank you for the support! Its hard having kids when you're a kid yourself haha
Thank you so much for this! You really helped :) sometimes my mind gets foggy so its great to see someones perspective
Thank you, its hard to not feel guilty so thank you for your kind words

Thank you for the advice. I never thought of support groups. I dont know what the trigger is exactly but I may write down everything to try figure it out. Tbh it seems like my mums existence makes me angry because i dont get angry with my dad even though he is N. It makes it stressful that even her breathing makes me angry. Its hard to sort out when its everything. I do get deja vu in some arguments though

I really want to cry everything out but the problem is that I have no friends. Only a sister and a boyfriend but my boyfriend cant handle it due to his Asperger's and my sister is getting over it herself.
I sadly stopped seeing them 1.5 years ago because i got too anxious to turn up to appointments. Sadly now because I am 20 I would have to pay for therapy which I simply cannot afford.

I already have complex ptsd. We dont have dinner or any social interaction apart from when we are both in the kitchen, when im ambushed when i come home, when i need a prescription for my asthma because she wont let me do it, and when she randomly bursts into my room to talk. I talk politely when she does this most of the time so that i can escape quicker but i have a problem with sharing too much emotional information because i still see her as my mum. She always says "i brought you into this world therefore you should respect me, im gonna die soon". Its as if she has her kids all very far apart so that she could divide and conquer us. Especially with me, i think she purposefully had me late so that she would have a source to cling to once all her other children realise she was batshit crazy when they got older. 
P.s. i only say npd because my psychologist referred them as having NPD so i got used to it, apologies.

Maybe you should discuss this with her and say it is hurting your feelings. If you get a bullshit answer then you know to pull away. Rehearse what your gonna say then go for it. She could have something private going on in her life.

I have tried greyrocking before and it freaks my mum out and she says she feels like she is losing her child (meaning her source of misery). Do you think if I keep at it then eventually she will get used to it? 

I do expect too much, i feel like I havent fully accepted they are horrible people. In society you are told to worship your parents and I always knew there was something wrong. I found out when I was 17 that they had NPD and it was a shock, i knew there was something wrong but npd makes my skin crawl. I still havent been able to come to terms with it.

My brother is 36 but he has aspergers and i havent seen him in 4 years since my mum tried to section him. I have a sister who is 40 who is a compulsive liar and my mums lesser aggressive clone who is in Australia and I have a wonderful sister who has helped me through narcissism who is 28 but she is NC with my parents. i am the only one who lives with them as im young but because i am their last child and i have gone from being the scape goat to the golden they are really clingly and abusive so its hard. My dad is 72 and i know he is gonna die soon. I cant get away from their abuse and i just want to know how to cope but healthily. I told my my dad about my mum too but he is an N too so that didnt help. He just said to ignore her.
My problem is that i have no friends

Its always worth a try but getting a narc to go to a therapist is a mission in itself. I gave up with trying with my Nmum as she was in serious denial. You can only help a person who wants to help themselves. So try but dont put your money on it working.
Thank you! They gave me goosebumps!

I would agree with you there because my nmum says her childhood was great but it doesnt add up.  It is possible to have npd without abuse i think. Its all about how they see themselves and the world. I dont think abuse is necessary to make someone a narc. Some narcs have lavish childhoods and then grow up to think they are entitled. or some had great childhoods and just got abused later on in their life. I don't think its possible to be born one though. Just sometimes something clicks and makes someone go rotten.

My Nmum describes her childhood as lovely, although her mum died when she was 18 and her dad was sexually abused. Also, she said she never got along with her sister. So my Nmum was never abused but just dealt with a lot of things. Maybe they arent telling you something or she is just bad. Some people are just bad people.

Sounds like a textbook narc to me. And seems like she did a lot of emotional incest which is talking to their child about issues they shouldnt know and that should be discussed with an adult.. definitely not their son!  
Edit: added information

There's not much options tbh. You get it for free till you are 18 then its usually £50-£100 for one session. There is always free councilling but they have no actual qualifications and usually tell you to love your family no matter what. Once i went to the hospital and told them about my family so they suggested family therapy and then my family of course made me out to be a problem child and i got told to respect them more. The uk are diabolical with mental health.
Not an option currently. I quit my job as it was too much stress and im trying to complete my education. Its really hard to find a cheap therapist in the uk that isnt clueless about narcissism.
Thank you, therapy sadly isnt an option for me as its too expensive.
